description: USE WHEN you want to know which market regimes break a strategy (buy_and_hold or rsi_30_70) and why. Adversarial evaluation in 3 layers: (1) outcome metrics in the worst regimes, (2) a vulnerability profile over 8 dimensions with severity, (3) the regime descriptors that couple most strongly to failure. Only strategies in the pre-computed outcome matrix can be challenged: 'buy_and_hold' and 'rsi_30_70' ('-' accepted for '_'). `asset` (optional) limits the worst-regime list to one catalogue asset; the vulnerability profile still spans all 63 regimes. Other strategies: tier2_stress_test (full tier, needs an access token). Vocabulary: ontology://strategy-vulnerabilities.

asset.description: Optional: list worst regimes of this catalogue asset only (SPY, QQQ, GOLD, BTC, ETH, WTI, VIX; aliases GLD, BTC-USD). VIX has three historical regimes and no synthetic ones. Default: all assets.
asset.title: Asset

strategy_id.description: Strategy id from the outcome matrix: 'buy_and_hold' (default) or 'rsi_30_70'. '-' and '_' are interchangeable.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: challenge_strategy
title: Challenge a strategy: find what breaks it (3-layer output)
